ED_DecisionText:
A 

At its 90th plenary meeting, on 22 June 2026, the General Assembly, on the proposal of its President, decided to suspend the debate on agenda item 10 at 3 p.m. on 23 June 2026, for the Assembly to hear statements from the Chairs of the panel discussions presenting summaries of the discussions, and to proceed to the consideration of draft resolution (Footnote: A/80/L.79.), on the understanding that the debate would continue after the action on the draft resolution.  


B 


At the same meeting, the Assembly, on the proposal of its President, recalling that, in line with paragraph 12 of resolution 80/256, three representatives from non-governmental organizations in consultative status with the Economic and Social Council, civil society organizations and the private sector had been invited to make statements at the plenary meeting, decided to allow these representatives to make statements at the end of the 91st plenary meeting in the morning of 23 June 2026 prior to the suspension of the debate.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
